name: Callooh Callay
text:
Long ago, a fairy tickled a vorpal dragon under the chin and pulled this +3 major striking vorpal longsword from the dragon's chin blade, then used it to slay a jabberwock. Strikes with this sword deal an additional 2d6 persistent bleed damage to the Tane and linnorms.

The DC of the vorpal rune's Snicker-Snack activation is DC 40 Fortitude save, and if you decapitate a creature with this ability, this sword automatically counteracts any ability or effect that would normally occur when the creature dies or is reduced to 0 Hit Points (such as a linnorm's death curse).

---
Activate—One, Two! 2

Frequency once per day

Effect Make two Strikes against the same target with Callooh Callay. If both Strikes hit, you can use your reaction to activate the vorpal rune's Snicker-Snack activation, even if you don't meet the trigger.

---
Activate—Rest Thee by the Tumtum 1 (concentrate)

Frequency once per 10 minutes

Effect You stand in uffish thought. You attempt to Recall Knowledge about a single creature you can see. If your check succeeds, you can Strike that creature with Callooh Callay or Stride toward that creature.

---
Destruction If Callooh Callay is swallowed by a jabberwock or other Tane and isn't removed for 1 year (by, for instance, killing the creature), the sword dissolves.
